# Documentation templates

Status: ready, empty templates. Date: 2026-10-16. Owner: project maintainer.

- [Idea](idea.md): copy into `docs/planning/ideas/`, then link the record in the idea index.
- [Campaign](campaign.md): copy into the private campaign records.
- [Decision](decision.md): copy into `docs/decisions/NNNN-topic.md` and update the index.
- [Work log](work-log.md): copy into `docs/log/YYYY-MM-DD-topic.md` and update the index.

Templates carry a Hindsight exclusion marker. After copying/filling a normal substantive template, remove that marker so it can be indexed. Exception: phase execution journals and their blank template keep `<!-- hindsight:ignore -->` permanently; synchronize a separate short sanitized milestone instead, as required by the [audit procedure](../how-to/phase-execution-audit.md). Never place customer data, account files or private information into templates or indexed documents.
